ce_rapport_explore_la_maniere_dont_vos_p: This report explores how your personalities, emotions, and relational needs intersect.
la_synastrie_est_l_etude_astrologique_de: Synastry is the astrological study of the relationship between two natal charts. It compares the positions of the planets of each person to highlight affinities, attractions, complementarities, and areas of tension that may influence the relationship.
chaque_interaction_astrologique_raconte_: Each astrological interaction tells a different part of your dynamic. Some connections naturally facilitate understanding and closeness, while others require more listening, patience, or adaptation.
ce_rapport_ne_cherche_pas_a_decider_si_u: This report does not seek to determine whether a relationship is good or bad. Rather, it reveals its deep functioning, potential for evolution, and the keys that can help both individuals better understand each other.
les_sections_suivantes_abordent_votre_co: The following sections address your overall compatibility, communication, emotional bond, attraction, strengths, and challenges. Each element should be read as a piece of a whole: a relationship is never summed up by a single sign or a single astrological aspect.
l_astrologie_propose_un_langage_symboliq: Astrology offers a symbolic language designed to promote reflection and self-knowledge. This report supports your understanding of the relationship without replacing your free will or personal experience.
